question: Which changes to pinned apps on the nav rail are worth making first?

experts.name: Security
experts.brief: You review the feature for security. Ask what a pinned app exposes, to whom, and for how long.

experts.name: Skeptic
experts.brief: You are the skeptic. Name what breaks: the input nobody tried, the state two features reach at once, the claim another expert made without checking it.

experts.name: Coordinator
experts.brief: You are the coordinator. Merge the proposals that say the same thing, rank the directions that remain, and mark the claims that cite nothing as weak.

proposals.author: security
proposals.title: Stop a pinned app's server when its project closes
proposals.argument: A pinned app is a dev server. Closing its project leaves it listening on its port until arcterm quits.

proposals.author: security
proposals.title: Bind a pinned app's server to localhost
proposals.argument: A server started with --host listens on every interface, and the rail pins a page by its url without checking that the url is localhost.

proposals.author: skeptic
proposals.title: Move the rail pins from localStorage to settings
proposals.argument: A cleared WebView2 profile loses them. railappsstore.ts keeps the pins in localStorage.

proposals.author: uxaudit
proposals.title: Show asleep and waking on the rail icon
proposals.argument: A sleeping app looks the same as a running one. railDot draws only error and warning, so the rail never says an app is asleep.

proposals.author: uxaudit
proposals.title: Show the empty rail slots with a pin hint
proposals.argument: The cap of 3 shows only once the rail is full.

replies.author: you
replies.text: Judge each idea on a Mac too: the app frame cannot reload in place there yet.

replies.author: skeptic
replies.text: Say which hosts count as localhost: 127.0.0.1 and ::1, nothing else.

replies.author: skeptic
replies.text: A third dot state: name what I do differently when I see it.

replies.author: you
replies.text: Does your transcript show anyone waiting on a sleeping app?
